notes.title: Buy the Fan Pack! Patch Notes 1.03
notes.notes:
Added a link to buy the fan pack from Steam to the title screen!!! (Please buy it if you can :~) 
 - it contains a 150+ page art book and a copy of the music! 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/769140/All_Our_Asias_Fan_Pack/

Fixed missing textures in a few spots
Made one area's exit a little clearer
Fixes a few typos
Fixed a parsing error on Linux that failed on certain system locales
